old.eligible: SELECT w.district, COUNT(DISTINCT l.person) AS people FROM workshops AS w JOIN trade_tracks AS t ON w.id=t.workshop JOIN licenses AS l ON t.trade=l.trade WHERE w.active=1 AND l.active=1 GROUP BY w.district
old.capacity: SELECT w.district, SUM(w.seats) AS seats FROM workshops AS w WHERE w.active=1 GROUP BY w.district
old.occupied: SELECT w.district, SUM(a.places) AS used FROM workshops AS w LEFT JOIN allocated AS a ON w.id=a.workshop WHERE w.active=1 GROUP BY w.district

add_terms_for_workshops: NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pauses AS p WHERE p.workshop=w.id)
